summary: Senior Associate, Investment Engineering & Analytics candidate with ~7 years building quantitative investment and risk analytics for institutional portfolios. At Moody's Analytics, designs and delivers production Python analytics pipelines and multi-asset models supporting portfolio managers; at Ortec Finance, ran systematic asset-only and surplus portfolio optimization on VaR/CVaR with stochastic macro scenario generators, risk decomposition, and factor-style attribution. CFA charterholder; dual MSc (Financial Modelling, Engineering); fluent in Python and SQL.

sections.heading: Production Models & Portfolio Analytics
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and portfolio analytics outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios ranging $5–25bn per engagement, cumulatively covering ~$50bn in assets.

Validate derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation, and review aggregation logic translating security-level exposures into portfolio-level risk and return metrics consumed by portfolio managers.

Review curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions prior to production release within a formal model governance framework — escalating outputs that are mathematically defensible but economically unsupported.

sections.heading: Data Pipelines & Engineering
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress macro scenarios across multi-year horizons.
Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable, auditable Python analytics pipelines with logging, validation, and reproducibility controls.
Architected configurable time-bucketed analytics (T+1 through multi-year) supporting funding, allocation, and refinancing decisions for live institutional portfolios.

sections.heading: AI-Augmented Development & Research Partnership
bullets: Built agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating code generation, validation scaffolding, anomaly detection, and documentation — reducing development cycle time an estimated 30–40% on comparable modules.
Partner with product owners and client investment teams to translate analytical requirements into production-grade Python; mentor junior colleagues on coding standards and review practices.
Onboarded U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms onto the PFaroe multi-asset analytics platform; validated model outputs post-deployment.
Scoped client analytical requirements into structured Product Owner requests, bridging investment teams and development to ship analytics enhancements into production.
Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 technology-transformation projects for Canadian and international insurers, aligning data, finance, actuarial, and IT workstreams.
Contributed to governance documentation and analytics design supporting regulatory-grade financial reporting.

Performed systematic asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform, with risk decomposition, contribution-to-risk, and near-efficient-frontier robustness analysis.
Built and interpreted stochastic macro scenario generators driving multi-asset return, inflation, rate, and currency dynamics for institutional portfolios.
Conducted factor- and asset-class-level risk attribution and hedging analysis (rates, inflation, FX) for international institutional clients.
Advised pension fund and institutional clients on Strategic and Tactical Asset Allocation via stress testing, sensitivity analysis, and scenario-based research.

Led ALM study for the University Pension Plan merger (three single-employer plans into a new jointly-sponsored plan), developing and validating models capturing funding-policy dynamics, duration, currency, inflation, and leverage overlays.
Presented research findings and portfolio recommendations to client investment committees on-site.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) – Western University, 2016
